description: Create or change the webhook endpoint (public HTTPS only) and its events: balance.low (needs balance_threshold_usd) and job.finished. The signing secret is returned only when the webhook is first created; store it then. Returns object account_webhook with url, events, balance_threshold, the signature headers (X-EveryInfra-Signature, X-EveryInfra-Timestamp, X-EveryInfra-Event-Id) and, on first creation, signing_secret. Example: {"url": "https://example.com/hooks/everyinfra", "events": ["balance.low", "job.finished"], "balance_threshold_usd": 20}. Needs the settings:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.

balance_threshold_usd.description: USD; required with balance.low, which fires once each time the balance drops below it

events.description: One or both events; replaces the current list

url.description: Public HTTPS URL, under 2000 characters, no #fragment

name: everyinfra_webhook_set
title: Set the account webhook
